I just finished my most difficult job. It was a 6 color with gradient and literally shouted for joy because it looked so good. Still have yet to do a CMYK or Simulated Process yet. Can't wait for that day. What are some of the cool things you've done?
What's your most difficult job and how did it go?

My most difficult job, although not my most complex, was a 4 color simulated process design on assorted color tees, hoodies, and ladies tanks.

The design was White, Red, Blue, Black (then highlight white). This was back in the day with just a manual press that didn't hold registeration and had awful off-contact, so the shirts would stick, pull ink, and everything else to try to keep these shirts from ruining. I ended up taping nickles to the screen arms to fix the off-contact issues, letting the shirts cool between every flash for about 30 seconds. The job was due the next morning (I used to have horrible time management...still kind of do sometimes). Anyhow, I finished the job at 7:15 after printing since 10AM the previous day, AND THEN I had to drive them almost 2 hours to deliver them to the motorcycle show they were for. I almost got in an accident because I fell asleep at the wheel...craziest and most difficult thing ever.

Moral of the story...always give yourself enough time to finish a job on your own schedule.
